core_principles: Pure dark theme with high contrast text.
Use React Native LinearGradient for all buttons and active states.
Extensive use of BlurView for glassmorphism panels, bottom sheets, and tab bars.
Fluid horizontal scrolling for media carousels.

screens.Login: Features centered logo with glowing hex/floral icon, gradient wordmark, glassy input cards, top right settings cog for server URL, and gradient Sign In pill.
screens.Home_Browse: Top category pills, country section headers with flags and channel counts, horizontal scroll carousels for channels/movies. Featured LIVE NOW hero card.
screens.Live_TV: Grid layout of channel cards with LIVE red badges, currently playing info.
screens.Player: Immersive full-screen player, floating transparent controls, back button, server info.

core_principles: Dark mode ONLY. No light mode toggle.
Use neon cyan and purple to highlight key data points and active states.
Avoid traditional white-background cards. Use semi-transparent #0D0E23 with 1px border-white/5.

sidebar.classes: w-64 bg-[#060714] border-r border-white/5 flex flex-col
sidebar.active_link: bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500/20 to-transparent border-l-2 border-cyan-400 text-white

stat_card.classes: bg-[#0D0E23]/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden
stat_card.neon_glow: absolute -top-10 -right-10 w-24 h-24 bg-purple-500/20 blur-2xl rounded-full

screens.Dashboard: Overview of Plex server stats (active streams, bandwidth, users online). Features glowing neon stat cards.
screens.Users: Data table managing access, revoke tokens, view watch history.
screens.Servers: List of connected Plex endpoints, sync status, latency metrics.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto. Use Unbounded for headings and Outfit for body.
For the mobile app, implement React Native's LinearGradient for the primary button and 'Quantum TV' wordmark.
For the mobile app, use absolute positioning with BlurView for the bottom sheet and glassy input fields.
For the admin web panel, enforce the dark theme explicitly. Do not use white cards.
Ensure the 'LIVE NOW' badges on mobile are high contrast red with tight letter spacing.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for both React Native and Web.
